name: InterContinental Fujairah Resort

address.street: Al Aqah Beach Dibba Road - Fujairah - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Where the Hajar Mountains dramatically meet the Gulf of Oman, creating the UAE's most spectacular natural amphitheater.
whats_special: This stunning resort sits on Fujairah's pristine coastline, the only UAE emirate located entirely on the Indian Ocean side. The property offers unparalleled diving and snorkeling access to some of the region's most vibrant coral reefs, while the nearby Hajar Mountains provide a dramatic backdrop that's completely different from Dubai's desert landscape.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dhow cruise from the resort's marina - Fujairah's east coast position offers breathtaking sunset views over the mountains rather than the typical ocean sunsets found elsewhere in the UAE.
dont_miss: The historic Fujairah Fort, one of the UAE's oldest and largest forts built in 1670, is just 10 minutes away. Also explore the ancient Al Bidya Mosque, the oldest mosque in the UAE dating back to 1446, and the nearby Wadi Wurayah National Park - a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve perfect for hiking and wildlife spotting.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine private beach access
Dramatic mountain and ocean views from most rooms and suites
Multiple dining venues offering diverse international and local cuisines
Comprehensive spa and wellness facilities with traditional treatments
cons: Remote location requiring longer travel time from major airports
Limited nearby attractions outside the resort property
